image_prompt: Elisabeth Cardel (Babet), a French governess in cyberpunk anime style. Her face is angular and austere, with high cheekbones and a firm jawline suggesting unwavering principle. Dark brown hair pulled back severely in a practical bun, with a few strands of silver catching neon light, framing her face with austere elegance. She wears a high-collared black Victorian dress with subtle technological accents—fine silver threading along the edges, faintly luminescent buttons suggesting futuristic undertones. Her posture is rigidly upright, conveying discipline and capability. Thin, graceful hands with long fingers suggest her musicality. Her expression is composed and observant, with a subtle hint of dry irony at the corners of her mouth. Overall bearing combines genteel propriety with intellectual toughness—a woman of principle rendered in sleek cyberpunk anime aesthetics, neither youthful nor aged, embodying formidable inner strength through restrained visual language.
